sourceIntent.authorStatement: Graduation of agency is an internal flywheel; the larger purpose is helping distinct agents inspect and coordinate their couplings and relationships.
unresolvedAmbiguities: Whether coupling or relationship should be the preferred first public word.

rootSubject.statement: Distinct agents are already coupled to one another and their environments; YAWN makes the consequential relationship state inspectable.

publicPurpose: Help distinct agents establish shared reference, coordinate direction, take bounded action, and learn from consequences without losing authorship.

supportingMechanisms.role: Make each Agent's situated model visible and correctable.
Describe the capacity to sense, choose, act, and adapt within the relationship.
Widen bounded autonomy only after repeated proof.

notClaimed: Graduation is the purpose of YAWN.
All participants must share one interpretation.
The View is the relationship itself.
